B4.0 hotfix (the 'player.gd:366 error' report, round 2): the owner's phone log was the style-wheel world-crawl fighting Fx. ROOT CAUSE (two parts): (1) style_wheel's refresh beat ran on the SCALED delta - at the crawl's 0.3 speed, a 2.8 s beat fires at 9.3 s REAL, past the 3.5 s slow-mo expiry, so the crawl lapsed and re-applied (world-speed flicker mid-browse) and the accumulated age crossed the 5 s watchdog; (2) Fx._apply_scale's MERGE branch never refreshed _scale_since, so a merged/re-issued slow-mo older than 5 s real got force-restored + WARN 'Fx watchdog: force-restored a stuck time scale' on every refresh cycle - warn spam the phone read as errors. FIX: the beat now runs on the real clock (Time.get_ticks_msec, immune to time_scale), and a merge counts as LIFE for the watchdog (net for UNTENDED slow-mos, not a hard 5 s lifespan). REGRESSION: smoke_combos long-browse check - wheel held open 6.5 s real, crawl must hold with no flicker and no watchdog line; negative-proofed on the old code (FAIL: crawl holds). Combos 59, smoke, combat, depth, controls 35, logic all green, 0 script errors.
